beschreibung:
Outspoken progressive commentator Jennifer Welch has gained attention for her fierce criticism of President Donald Trump and Vice President JD Vance, with her provocative rhetoric generating strong reactions from both supporters and opponents. Her approach has sparked debate over whether Democrats need to adopt a more aggressive political strategy to counter the MAGA movement.

Supporters argue that Democrats must fight fire with fire, while critics warn that increasingly combative rhetoric risks deepening America’s political divisions and undermining claims to the moral high ground.

Welch’s new book, Not Today, Fascists, sets out her political views and examines the battle between the American left and right, the Trump presidency and the future direction of the Democratic Party.

Piers Morgan is joined by Welch plus host of the Daily Wire’s Isabel Brown Show, Isabel Brown, to discuss.

Then; Hollywood actor Kelsey Grammer joins Piers to discuss American history, conservatism and the state of the United States, following the release of The American Opus, a major work exploring the American story.

Grammer, one of Hollywood’s most prominent conservative voices, argues that the American experience has often been poorly represented and understood, drawing on his long-standing interest in the country’s history.
